subject: Compressed review cycle sprint & notice plan
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compressed review cycle sprint - proposal and asks

Team —

Given the hiring freeze and product timelines, execs have asked that we compress the upcoming review cycle to a two-week "sprint" window for managers. I sketched a lightweight plan attached (manager-questionnaire-v2.docx) and a pared-down communications slate (comm-drafts-v1.pdf). Key asks:–

1) Can people run manager calibration and sign-off within 7 business days?
2) Confirm minimal form fields we need to preserve calibration fidelity (I suggested scores + 2-line impact note).
3) Approve a short notice to ICs that preserves confidentiality for sensitive roles (draft in PDF).

Operational constraints I took into account: cache of prior year evals, limited HR reviewers, and a single all-hands pause day on Sep 7.

Please reply with: 
- Your redlines to the manager form by EOD Sep 1
- Confirmation on calibration cadence (live vs. async)

If we align today we can get Brightlane to provision the short-form packet and a triaged audit trail for legal.

Thanks —
Priyom
Priyom Das
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compressed review cycle sprint - proposal and asks

Priyom —

Thanks for the concise plan. Quick thoughts: 
- I can run calibration live on Sep 9 (30–45m) but need 1 full day before to review manager packets; so managers should have final packets by Sep 8 morning.
- Strong +1 to the minimal fields you proposed. Please remove free-form "development notes" from the main packet — that can live in manager docs.
- For sensitive roles we should route notices through PrivilegedOps and use the quiet-notice template (I attached inline edits).

Attachment: NOTE: I left line comments in manager-questionnaire-v2.docx (see file).

Lauren
VP People Partners

From: Brightlane HR <hr@brightlane.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 13:26:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Compressed review cycle sprint - Brightlane availability

Thanks for the note, Priyom —

We can support a compressed packet but need the manager list and employment IDs by Sep 2 EOB to guarantee audit logs and signed Acknowledgement receipts. Two operational notes: 
1) Our short-packet will capture role-level impact statements (one-liner) and compensation recommendation bucket only.
2) For sensitive roles we can enable redaction routing; however, that adds 24–48 hrs to delivery for those packets.

If you send the CSV export and the final manager questionnaire we will queue it for a Sep 6 run.

Best,
Rhea Kumar
Operations Lead, Brightlane HR

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compressed review cycle sprint - proposal and asks

Looping in calendar + comms items. Two tactical items: 

1) I've created a compressed .ics (compressed-cycle-timeline.ics) that reserves Sep 6–10 as manager work window and Sep 9 for live calibration (30m). I propose staggered release to ICs: teams with sensitive roles get notice on Sep 10, others Sep 11.

2) For notices: proposed subject line is "Upcoming review window: what to expect (short update)" — keeps it low-signal. Drafts are in comm-drafts-v1.pdf.

I will prepare a CSV of managers and export from Workday by Sep 2 noon. Also flagged legal to approve the redaction SLA.

-Marissa
Senior People Ops Manager

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compressed review cycle sprint - proposal and asks

All —

This looks good. Confirmed: 
- Priyom: get manager CSV + final questionnaire to Brightlane by EOD Sep 2 (per Rhea).
- Marissa: upload .ics and lock Sep 9 calibration 30m.
- Lauren: run live calibration and bring 3 examples (1 high/1 mid/1 low) to anchor scores.

I'll notify Execs that we are proceeding with a compressed sprint and ask for no ad-hoc exceptions except for staffed sensitive-role cases.

If nobody objects I will mark this Plan+Timeline approved and ask Legal to fast-track the redaction agreement.

—Vivek
VP, People & Talent
